name: @depup/datadog__openfeature-node-server
description: Node.js server bindings for OpenFeature (wraps @datadog/flagging-core) (with updated dependencies)

scripts.build:cjs: rm -rf cjs && tsc -p tsconfig.cjs.json && yarn replace-build-env cjs
scripts.build:esm: rm -rf esm && tsc -p tsconfig.esm.json && yarn replace-build-env esm
scripts.//build:types: Bundles @openfeature/* types into a self-contained index.d.ts with no external imports, required for SSI where dd-trace's node_modules can't reach the customer's @openfeature/server-sdk. See https://github.com/DataDog/dd-trace-js/pull/9570
scripts.build:types: trap 'rm -f src/.dts-entry.ts' EXIT; printf '/// <reference path="./global.d.ts" />\nexport * from "./index"\n' > src/.dts-entry.ts && dts-bundle-generator -o index.d.ts src/.dts-entry.ts --external-inlines @openfeature/core @openfeature/server-sdk --no-banner --export-referenced-types false
